payload.note: Exact bounded-oscillation gradient theorem: on every finite connected undirected graph, if m=min Omega and M=max Omega, then ||grad A||^2 >= omega_G^2 (m/M)^12 ||r||^2. The constant is independent of graph size, so every normalized-gradient collapse sequence must have M/m tending to infinity. This closes the entire fixed-oscillation sector but does not prove Gibbs rarity of the escaping sector, a Witten/Poincare transfer, or the interacting H^-1 estimate; those remain the active gate.
